protected_invariants: no credential is created, requested, read, printed, logged, copied or persisted by this mission; no credential value appears in the repository, the diff, a test fixture or an evidence file, and the transport refuses to construct without explicitly injected credentials

the R2 transport performs no implicit credential discovery: no environment fallback, no ~/.aws or profile fallback, no instance-metadata fallback and no default provider chain, even when AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_PROFILE are set in the environment

Signature V4 is never hand-written: signing is delegated entirely to @aws-sdk/client-s3, and no AWS4-HMAC-SHA256, StringToSign, X-Amz-, credentialScope or HMAC primitive may appear in the backup sources
@aws-sdk/client-s3 is the only new runtime dependency, and it is loaded on demand rather than re-exported, so the offline CLIs and the unit tests never link the network client

create-only is atomic and never emulated: the filesystem transport uses O_CREAT|O_EXCL and the S3-compatible transport uses If-None-Match: *, so a race-prone HEAD-then-PUT create-if-absent is never used
no transport exposes a delete or a bucket-administration verb; bucket locks, lifecycle rules and the Cloudflare REST API are out of scope and are never called, and Cloudflare is never contacted

every root is explicit: there is no default authority root, ledger root, transport root or restore destination, and no code path falls back to /home/xupeng/FootballPrediction.clean-dev/data/market_evidence/live or any other production path

the governed production area is named exactly once in executable code, inside the PRODUCTION_MARKERS denylist whose purpose is to refuse it, and is matched on whole path segments rather than as a substring
both ops CLIs reject rather than ignore every live-target flag, never echo a rejected value, and accept no endpoint, bucket, region, credential or profile flag: LIVE_R2_CLI_WIRING=NOT_IMPLEMENTED

the completeness marker is written LAST and is the sole definition of an accepted generation, so an interrupted write leaves an unverifiable partial generation instead of a snapshot that looks complete
nothing in this tooling deletes, repairs in place or overwrites: a failed generation, a failed verification and a restore destination are all left exactly as they were found

the isolated restore proof is performed by the canonical readers pointed at the restored root, at the stage-d-runtime-filesystem-permission/v1 modes, and the fresh-process proof inherits no environment beyond PATH so an ambient credential or production path cannot produce the result

the backup tooling is explicit-invocation only and is not integrated into atomicPublisher, stageDOperations, the publication path, the scheduler, controlled initialization, the request cycle or the transaction commit

POLICY_B_STATUS stays PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED and RPO_ZERO_COMMITTED_TRANSACTIONS stays NOT_YET_ENFORCED: adopting the per-commit invocation policy, and the availability argument it needs, is a separate Owner decision

the accepted authority is neither read for its content nor rewritten: the ACCEPTED AUTHORITY BASELINE is used only as a documented identity to interpret against, and the offline fixtures are synthetic authorities built through the real pipeline, because production must not be copied or mutated by this mission

the historical pre-epoch request accounting uncertainty is preserved verbatim: REQUEST_ACCOUNTING_PRE_EPOCH_LOWER_BOUND=AT_LEAST_2_CONFIRMED and REQUEST_ACCOUNTING_PRE_EPOCH_EXACT_TOTAL=UNKNOWN are not reinterpreted
no test contacts Cloudflare, R2, AWS, The Odds API or any remote S3 endpoint: every test runs behind a network tripwire that fails on the first outbound attempt, and the suite asserts zero attempts
BLOCKER_3 stays OPEN and is not closed by tooling existing: GATE_2 stays NOT_ACCEPTED, GATE_3 stays NOT_AUTHORIZED and STAGE_D_STARTED stays NO

this mission stops at the merge gate: it does not merge, does not provision R2, does not create a bucket, does not write an object, does not perform a backup and does not restore anything into production
forbidden_side_effects: creating, requesting, reading, printing, logging, copying or persisting any credential, API token or secret value, and any command that would echo one
contacting Cloudflare, R2, AWS, The Odds API or any remote S3 endpoint, and executing any live S3 request
provisioning, creating, modifying or deleting a bucket, and configuring bucket locks, lifecycle rules or bucket policy through any API
hand-writing Signature V4, or adding any runtime dependency other than @aws-sdk/client-s3
running a real backup, copying production, restoring into or near production, and mutating any production content, metadata or permission
integrating backup invocation into atomicPublisher, stageDOperations, the publication path, the scheduler, controlled initialization, the request cycle or the transaction commit
deleting, overwriting or repairing in place any snapshot generation, restored root, transport object or verification finding, including emulating a delete through any other verb

modifying any excluded or forbidden path, including the canonical readers, the transaction store, the quota accounting implementation, provider adapters, scheduler code, production config, .github/**, database/**, data/**, deploy/** or docker/**
Stage D execution, scheduler enablement, provider request, quota consumption, controlled initialization, transaction creation, training, prediction, backtest or model activation
